name: Ikebukuro
tagline: Shinjuku in 7 minutes and Shibuya in 12 minutes. Served by 9 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, where JR East, Tobu, Seibu and Tokyo Metro run 9 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 18 minutes to Otemachi, 7 minutes to Shinjuku, 12 minutes to Shibuya and 33 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 32.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 32.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 31.6 m to 33.6 m, a difference of 2.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 19 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 宏明会池袋大久保病院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 榎本クリニック, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 9 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and JR Saikyo Line run through it. Narita Express and JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line also call here. Tobu Tojo Line and Seibu Ikebukuro Line are available too. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line stop here as well. Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line stop here as well. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line stop here as well. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 4 lines, Tobu runs 1 line, Seibu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 3 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Saikyo Line runs at 167% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 板橋→池袋, which includes this station. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153%. Its busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is likewise not on. Narita Express and JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Toden-Zoshigaya is ahead on quiet, but Ikebukuro is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Ikebukuro. It takes 8 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Ikebukuro. One-room rents run about ¥8,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Ikebukuro is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Ikebukuro. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Ikebukuro. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 higher.

noiseSources: 明治通 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: 9 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
